title: mdait Configuration
description: Configuration file for mdait (Markdown AI Translator)

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE support

transPairs.description: Translation pairs configuration. Define source and target directories for translation.

sourceDir.description: Path to the directory containing source language documents (relative to workspace root)

targetDir.description: Path to the directory to store target language documents (relative to workspace root)

oneOf.description: Glob pattern for files and directories to exclude from translation and sync processing
List of glob patterns for files and directories to exclude

level.description: Heading level at which to automatically insert mdait markers (1-6, or 0 to disable). Can be overridden in frontmatter.

autoDelete.description: Automatically delete units on target side when deleted on source side during sync

autoSyncOnSave.description: Automatically sync files when saved (only files with mdait markers)

ai.description: AI provider configuration for translation and term processing

provider.description: AI provider to use for translation

vendor.description: VS Code Language Model API vendor identifier (used by 'default'/'vscode-lm' provider)

model.description: AI model name to use with the selected provider

timeoutSec.description: Timeout in seconds for the initial response and between streaming chunks

apiKey.description: OpenAI API key. Can use ${env:VARIABLE_NAME} syntax to reference environment variables.

baseURL.description: OpenAI API base URL (optional, defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1)

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

enableStatsLogging.description: Enable AI communication statistics logging to .mdait/logs/ai-stats.log for debugging purposes

logPromptAndResponse.description: Enable detailed AI logging including prompts and responses to .mdait/logs/ai-detailed.log (warning: may contain sensitive data)

skipCodeBlocks.description: Whether to exclude code blocks from translation targets when translating markdown

keys.description: Frontmatter keys to translate. Empty array disables frontmatter translation.

contextSize.description: Number of surrounding units (before and after) to include as context for AI translation. Higher values provide more context but increase token usage. Set to 0 to disable context.

retryLimit.description: Maximum number of retries for translation failures. Limited to 1-5; values below 1 are raised to 1, and values 6+ are capped at 5.

maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size in bytes for non-Markdown file translation. Files exceeding this limit are skipped with a warning.

extensions.description: Additional file extensions to include for translation across all translation pairs. Markdown (.md) is always included.

primaryLang.description: Primary language code shared across terminology and TM features

enabled.description: Enable or disable the TM feature. When disabled, both tm-commit and trans TM references are deactivated.

maxReferences.description: Maximum number of TM references to include in translation prompts. Higher values provide more context but increase token usage.

retryLimit.description: Maximum number of focused retries for tm-commit guard failures. Limited to 1-5; values below 1 are raised to 1, and values 6+ are capped at 5.

minQueryLength.description: Minimum character count for a normalized line to be used as a TM search query. Lines shorter than this are excluded to avoid noise from table fragments etc.

prompts.description: Custom prompt overrides. Specify file paths (relative to workspace root) for each prompt ID.

trans.translate.description: Path to custom Markdown translation prompt file

trans.revisePatch.description: Path to custom revision patch translation prompt file

term.detect.description: Path to custom term detection prompt file

term.extractFromTranslations.description: Path to custom term extraction from translations prompt file

term.translateTerms.description: Path to custom term translation prompt file

tm.splitSentences.description: Path to custom TM sentence alignment prompt file
